{{Quote|Princess, we have a visitor. We've picked up something outside the base in Zone Twelve, moving east.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Zone Twelve''' was the designation given by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to an area of land beyond the Alliance headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Echo Station 3-8]] was located near Zone Twelve. A [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] also moved through this area.
